headline.en: Seoul rallied a second day — the KOSPI rose 1.39% to 5,137.89 and the Kosdaq 3.32% to 684.81, both closing at the day's high after an intraday dip below 5,000 — but foreigners sold again (−₩405.5bn KOSPI, −₩212.7bn Kosdaq) and institutions carried the tape. Overnight Wall Street broke: Anthropic opened 34% above its $83 IPO price and closed about 17% up, yet the S&P 500 fell 2.02% to 7,175.83 for a sixth straight loss, the Dow lost 1,101 points to 49,097.06 and the Nasdaq 2.25%. The 10-year par eased to 5.04%; the won firmed to 1,330.0. Two of three nails lit on the data file, one on the latest prints; the biotech gate stays shut.

note.en: Thursday: Dow −1,101.11pt (−2.19%) to 49,097.06, its first close below 50,000 since June; S&P 500 −2.02% to 7,175.83, a sixth straight loss and further below its 200-day average (7,348.54); Nasdaq Composite −2.25% to 23,879.20 (CNBC, updated 5:20 p.m. ET). Anthropic (ANT) opened at $111.50 against its $83 IPO price and closed about 17% higher (CNBC; Forbes puts the close at $97.17), and the indexes hit their lows as it began trading. Nvidia and Micron gave up early gains; AMD fell nearly 8% after Hunterbrook disclosed a short position tied to alleged China export-control breaches; the VIX touched about 29, its highest since March (CNBC). Data were soft: Philadelphia Fed manufacturing 6.3 vs 18 expected, prices paid 58.2; initial jobless claims 203,000 vs 197,000 (CNBC). Brent settled +3 cents at $91.98 as tanker mine reports in Hormuz offset a US crude build (Reuters). The dollar index touched 103.97 in Asian hours, a 19-month high (Seoul Economic Daily). Treasury par: 10-year 5.04%, 2-year 4.76%, 30-year 5.40%.

VIX는 29 안팎까지 올라 3월 이후 최고(CNBC). 지표도 부진했다. 필라델피아 연은 제조업지수 6.3(예상 18), 가격지불지수 58.2, 신규 실업수당 청구 20.3만 건(예상 19.7만 건). Brent는 호르무즈 기뢰 피격 보도가 미 원유 재고 증가를 상쇄하며 3센트 오른 $91.98로 정산(로이터). 달러인덱스는 아시아 시간대 103.97까지 올라 19개월 최고(서울경제). 재무부 par 기준 10년물 5.04%, 2년물 4.76%, 30년물 5.40%.

Pharma did join this rebound: the Kosdaq pharma index +3.6% and KOSPI pharma +1.6% (Medicopharma, 17:30 KST), led by the six healthcare names being added to the Kosdaq 150 on 11 Dec (average +11.8%). In the US the latest XBI close in the data file is $145.04 on 18 Nov (−0.17%); a VIX near 29 and a sixth S&P 500 loss are no reopening signal. The gate reopens only when the Kosdaq holds 700 with foreigners buying.

read.en: The market got the event it was waiting for and sold it. Anthropic's debut was a success on its own terms — a $111.50 open against an $83 offer — and the S&P 500 still fell 2.02%, with the low printed as the stock began trading. That is what late-stage liquidity stress looks like: supply of AI paper meets a 5% ten-year, a 19-month-high dollar and a December hike priced as near-certain, and the marginal buyer chooses cash. Seoul ran the other way for a second day, and the shape matters: both indexes fell hard at the open, then closed at the high on institutional money, chip short-covering, a China content headline and Kosdaq 150 rebalancing. Foreigners sold through all of it — ₩405.5bn on the KOSPI and ₩212.7bn on the Kosdaq, the seventh straight day there. The won's fourth day of gains is the one genuinely supportive signal, and it is why a nail went dark on the latest prints. But a rally that institutions build and foreigners sell into is a range trade, not a turn, and Friday opens after New York's worst day in the run. Alteogen's German appeal was heard on 19 Nov; no ruling has been reported. The stance stays defensive until the Kosdaq holds 700 with foreigners buying.
read.kr: 시장은 기다리던 이벤트를 받아 들고 팔았다. 앤트로픽 상장 자체는 성공이었다. 공모가 $83에 시초가 $111.50. 그런데도 S&P 500은 2.02% 빠졌고, 저점은 바로 그 첫 거래 시점에 찍혔다. 후기 유동성 스트레스의 전형이다. AI 공급 물량이 10년물 5%, 19개월 최고 달러, 사실상 확정된 12월 인상과 맞부딪히자 한계 매수자는 현금을 택했다. 서울은 이틀째 반대로 움직였는데, 그 모양새가 중요하다. 양 지수 모두 장초반 급락한 뒤 기관 자금, 반도체 숏커버링, 한한령 완화 헤드라인, 코스닥150 리밸런싱에 힘입어 고가로 끝났다. 그 내내 외국인은 팔았다. 코스피 4,055억, 코스닥 2,127억 원이며 코스닥은 7거래일 연속이다. 4거래일째 이어진 원화 강세가 유일하게 의미 있는 지지 신호이고, 최신 공표치 기준 악재 하나가 꺼진 것도 그 덕이다. 하지만 기관이 쌓고 외국인이 그 위에 파는 반등은 박스권 매매이지 추세 전환이 아니며, 금요일 장은 이번 하락 국면 중 뉴욕 최악의 하루 뒤에 열린다. 알테오젠 독일 항소심은 11/19 열렸지만 판결 보도는 아직 없다. 외국인 매수 속에 코스닥이 700선을 지킬 때까지 판단은 방어적으로 유지한다.
